summary: First-iteration testing of PlantCare. Backend has 14 passing API tests (health, users, plants CRUD, recommendations, reminders, identify-error-path). Frontend loads OK, homepage and Recommendations page render correctly. CRITICAL: AI plant identification (/api/identify) is completely broken - Gemini API key rejected and model names appear hallucinated. Several CRUD identity inconsistencies and image mismatches found.

critical.issue: Returns 500 - Gemini rejects key with 'API_KEY_INVALID'. Model 'gemini-3-flash-preview' is not a valid model id (knowledge cutoff 2026: valid Gemini models via emergent integrations include gemini-2.5-flash / gemini-2.5-pro). Anthropic model 'claude-sonnet-4-6' is also likely invalid (current is claude-sonnet-4-5). AI flow is unusable.

Even if LLMs worked, code does NOT parse the JSON returned by Gemini/Claude. It returns hardcoded common_name='Identificazione in corso', hardcoded care_guide, and dumps truncated raw LLM strings into description/care_guide.claude_details. The dual-AI pipeline is essentially a stub.
POST returns id = str(ObjectId), but GET/PUT look up by email (db.users.find_one({'email': user_id})). The id returned from POST is unusable to fetch the user. Inconsistent identity.

POST returns id = str(ObjectId); GET re-derives id = added_at; DELETE expects added_at as plant_id. The id returned from save is useless and clients must re-fetch list to delete. Same issue in /api/reminders.

minor.issue: image_url stores only request.image_base64[:100] (a useless truncation). Should either store full data URL, upload to storage, or omit.
Accepts enabled as a bool QUERY param instead of JSON body - awkward and non-idiomatic. user_id also required as query.
id derived from added_at string (ISO timestamp) - collisions possible if two plants saved in same millisecond; also leaks creation time as id.

ui_bugs.issue: Only 'Le Mie Piante' and 'Profilo' links shown in top nav. Scanner, Recommendations, Reminders are reachable only via routing/buttons but not from header. Causes UX confusion.

integration_issues.issue: User upload -> /api/identify returns 500 due to invalid Gemini key/model. Entire AI feature non-functional.

issues: Image mismatch: Sansevieria card shows a Peace Lily (Spathiphyllum) photo, not snake plant.
Several plant cards (Pothos / Felce di Boston / Monstera / Ficus Lyrata) appear to render the same/similar Pothos image - Unsplash URLs broken or duplicated.
Light filter dropdown uses browser-default native select instead of shadcn Select component.

action_items: Fix /api/identify: use valid emergent integration model ids (e.g. 'gemini-2.5-flash' for Gemini and 'claude-sonnet-4-5' for Claude). Verify EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in backend/.env is current.

Implement actual JSON parsing of Gemini and Claude responses in /api/identify and merge them into the IdentifyResponse fields (common_name, scientific_name, description, care_guide, pet_friendly, suitable_for_user).
Unify resource identity: return the same id from POST that GET/DELETE will use. Recommend using uuid4 strings stored as 'id' in Mongo and exclude _id in projections.
Lookup users by id (or email consistently) - currently the path param is named user_id but query is on email field.
Fix recommendation image URLs (replace broken/duplicate Unsplash links) or host static images.
Add Scanner / Recommendations / Reminders to header navigation; ensure data-testid attributes on nav links.
Replace native select for light filter with shadcn Select for design consistency.
Change PUT /api/reminders to accept JSON body {enabled: bool} instead of query params.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/identify pipeline ignores actual LLM output and returns hardcoded data - misleading 'completed' response. Major business-logic bug.
server.py: get_user/update_user route param is named user_id but treated as email. Either rename param or store/lookup by id.
server.py: Uses str(ObjectId) only when inserting but never retrieves by it - inconsistent identity model violates code-review rule on ObjectId handling.
Pydantic v1 syntax (.dict()) used; if backend is Pydantic v2 this will emit DeprecationWarnings. Switch to .model_dump().
No input validation on email format; CreateUserRequest accepts any string for email.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 pytest cases pass, but /api/identify only validated on error path)
success_rate.frontend: 70% (UI loads & recommendations OK; identify flow unusable)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed user (TEST_demo@plantcare.com) and TEST_Pothos plant; plant is cleaned up by test_delete_plant. TEST user is left in DB (no delete endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_api.py as regression suite. After main agent fixes /api/identify (valid models + JSON parsing), extend test_identify_with_small_image with a real plant image (>= 256x256 jpg) and assert that common_name is not the stub 'Identificazione in corso'. Verify id consistency between POST and GET for users and plants after fix. Frontend Scanner page upload flow was not exercised end-to-end because backend identify is broken.
rca of the issue: The /api/identify 500 is caused by invalid Gemini model name 'gemini-3-flash-preview' passed to LlmChat.with_model('gemini', ...). litellm routes through Gemini's REST API and returns API_KEY_INVALID/INVALID_ARGUMENT when model id is unknown for the project. Reproduction: POST /api/identify with any base64 image -> 500 with detail 'GeminiException ... API key not valid'. Mitigation: switch to a supported model id from emergent integrations (e.g. 'gemini-2.5-flash') and similarly for Anthropic ('claude-sonnet-4-5'), then parse JSON output from the LLMs before composing IdentifyResponse.
